description: A Janus cluster's members - VRRP, peers, stick tables, traffic - and the cluster as the Controller sees it - https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/metrics.md

panels.description: The cluster's members whose Janus exporter answers (janus_cluster_info), those that stopped answering within the hour, and the members the Controller records - when it is scraped.

targets.expr: count(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or vector(0)

count((janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"} or (last_over_time(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}[1h]) unless on (instance) up{job="$job"} == 1)) unless on (instance) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or vector(0)
max(janus_cluster_members{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})

panels.title: Members

panels.description: The member holding each VRRP instance (MASTER) - [VRRP](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/vrrp.md), the keepalived extension. Two names for one instance: split brain. Nothing: no member holds it, or the cluster has no VRRP.

targets.expr: max by (exported_instance, member) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="MASTER"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"} == 1)

panels.title: Virtual address

panels.description: Members that are MASTER of each VRRP instance: one. None: nobody answers for the address; two or more: split brain (the JanusClusterVRRPNoMaster and JanusClusterVRRPSplitBrain alerts).

targets.expr: sum by (exported_instance) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="MASTER"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"})

panels.title: VRRP masters

panels.description: HAProxy's connections from each member to the others (janus_cluster_peer_up): the stick tables replicate over them.

targets.expr: sum((janus_cluster_peer_up{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or vector(0)
count((janus_cluster_peer_up{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Peers

panels.description: Each member's stick tables, per peer: synced while the peer keeps up with the member's updates (janus_cluster_peer_table_synced).

targets.expr: count((janus_cluster_peer_table_synced{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"} == 1) or vector(0)
count((janus_cluster_peer_table_synced{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stick tables

panels.description: The Controller's view ([clusters](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/clusters.md)): the version its members should run, the members that don't, those whose configuration changed on the node (drift), and those its last apply or check failed on.

targets.expr: max(janus_cluster_desired_version{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
count(janus_cluster_member_on_desired_version{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"} == 0) or 0 * max(janus_cluster_desired_version{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
count(max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_drift{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"}) == 1) or 0 * max(janus_cluster_desired_version{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
count(janus_cluster_member_error{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"} == 1) or 0 * max(janus_cluster_desired_version{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})

panels.title: Configuration

panels.description: One line per member, as its Janus exporter tells it - a member whose exporter stopped answering stays an hour, Exporter down. VRRP: MASTER when it holds one of the cluster's VRRP instances at least, else its worst state; Priority: its highest, after tracking. Stick tables: synced when every peer keeps up with every table. - : none (no VRRP, a member alone).

targets.expr: max by (instance, member) ((up{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) (janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"} or (last_over_time(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}[1h]) unless on (instance) up{job="$job"} == 1)))
max by (instance, member, version) ((janus_build_info{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (instance, member) ((janus_haproxy_up{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"})

min by (instance, member) (sum by (instance, member, exported_instance) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="MASTER"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) + 2 * sum by (instance, member, exported_instance) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="FAULT"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) + 3 * sum by (instance, member, exported_instance) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="BACKUP"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) + 4 * sum by (instance, member, exported_instance) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="INIT"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) + 5 * sum by (instance, member, exported_instance) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="STOP"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}))
max by (instance, member) ((janus_vrrp_instance_effective_priority{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"})
sum by (instance, member) ((janus_cluster_peer_up{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"})
sum by (instance, member) ((1 - janus_cluster_peer_up{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"})
min by (instance, member) ((janus_cluster_peer_table_synced{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"})

panels.title: Members

panels.description: What the [Controller](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/clusters.md) records of each member - every 10 minutes, every minute while one fails, and after each operation. Version: the one it last took whole; Desired: whether that is the cluster's; Drifted: managed domains changed on the node since (the next apply puts them back); Released: domains its users took back; Apply or check: the Controller's last on it (the cluster's page says why it failed); Service: drained or not; then its peers.

targets.expr: max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_applied_version{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_on_desired_version{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
sum by (member) (janus_cluster_member_drift{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
sum by (member) (janus_cluster_member_released{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_error{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_drained{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_peers_up{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_peers{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_tables_synced{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_checked_timestamp_seconds{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"}) * 1000

panels.title: Members as the Controller sees them

panels.description: Each member's state in each VRRP instance over time: the MASTER holds the virtual address.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_instance, member) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="MASTER"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) + 2 * sum by (exported_instance, member) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="BACKUP"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) + 3 * sum by (exported_instance, member) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="FAULT"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) + 4 * sum by (exported_instance, member) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="INIT"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) + 5 * sum by (exported_instance, member) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="STOP"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or on (member) label_replace(max by (member) (0 * janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) - 1, "exported_instance", "-", "", "")

panels.title: Who holds the address

panels.description: Members MASTER of each VRRP instance over time: one. None: nobody answered for the address; two or more: split brain.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_instance) ((janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", state="MASTER"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or on () label_replace((0 * count(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) - 1), "exported_instance", "-", "", "")

panels.title: Masters

panels.description: Times a member became MASTER of a VRRP instance (janus_vrrp_instance_became_master_total), per interval: it took the address over. Nothing drawn: no failover.

targets.expr: (sum by (exported_instance, member) ((janus_vrrp_instance_became_master_total{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) - sum by (exported_instance, member) (janus_vrrp_instance_became_master_total{job="$job"} offset $__interval * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"} offset $__interval)) > 0
0 * count(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"})

panels.title: Failovers

panels.description: Each member's priority in each VRRP instance after tracking: HAProxy not serving lowers it (track_file), and the highest becomes MASTER.

targets.expr: max by (exported_instance, member) ((janus_vrrp_instance_effective_priority{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"})

panels.title: VRRP priority

panels.description: HAProxy's connection from each member to each of its peers over time ([clusters](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/cluster.md)).

targets.expr: max by (member, peer) ((janus_cluster_peer_up{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or on (member) label_replace(max by (member) (0 * janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) - 1, "peer", "-", "", "")

panels.title: Peers

panels.description: Each member's stick tables over time: synced while every peer keeps up with its updates - all acknowledged, or under traffic within two seconds every one made before.

targets.expr: min by (member, table) ((janus_cluster_peer_table_synced{job="$job"}) * on (instance) group_left (member) janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or on (member) label_replace(max by (member) (0 * janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) - 1, "table", "-", "", "")

panels.title: Stick tables

panels.description: Sessions each member's frontends accepted, per second. From HAProxy's own exporter (the HAProxy job; [HAProxy's own metrics](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/metrics.md#haproxys-own-metrics)), on the same host as the member's Janus exporter.

targets.expr: sum by (member) (label_replace(sum by (instance) (rate(haproxy_frontend_sessions_total{job="$haproxy"}[$__rate_interval])), "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?") * on (host) group_left (member) label_replace(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?"))

panels.title: Sessions

panels.description: HTTP requests each member's frontends received, per second. From HAProxy's own exporter (the HAProxy job; [HAProxy's own metrics](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/metrics.md#haproxys-own-metrics)), on the same host as the member's Janus exporter.

targets.expr: sum by (member) (label_replace(sum by (instance) (rate(haproxy_frontend_http_requests_total{job="$haproxy"}[$__rate_interval])), "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?") * on (host) group_left (member) label_replace(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?"))

panels.title: HTTP requests

panels.description: Each member's HAProxy's connections now. From HAProxy's own exporter (the HAProxy job; [HAProxy's own metrics](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/metrics.md#haproxys-own-metrics)), on the same host as the member's Janus exporter.

targets.expr: sum by (member) (label_replace(sum by (instance) (haproxy_process_current_connections{job="$haproxy"}), "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?") * on (host) group_left (member) label_replace(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?"))

panels.title: Connections

panels.description: The share of time each member's HAProxy threads weren't idle. From HAProxy's own exporter (the HAProxy job; [HAProxy's own metrics](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/metrics.md#haproxys-own-metrics)), on the same host as the member's Janus exporter.

targets.expr: max by (member) (label_replace(1 - avg by (instance) (haproxy_process_idle_time_percent{job="$haproxy"}) / 100, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?") * on (host) group_left (member) label_replace(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?"))

panels.title: HAProxy busy

panels.description: The share of time each member's CPUs weren't idle. From node_exporter (the node job; [the prometheus-node-exporter extension](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/metrics.md#the-node-exporter)), on the same host as the member's Janus exporter.

targets.expr: max by (member) (label_replace(1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$node", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])), "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?") * on (host) group_left (member) label_replace(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?"))

panels.title: CPU busy

panels.description: The share of each member's memory not available to new processes. From node_exporter (the node job; [the prometheus-node-exporter extension](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/metrics.md#the-node-exporter)), on the same host as the member's Janus exporter.

targets.expr: max by (member) (label_replace(1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="$node"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="$node"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?") * on (host) group_left (member) label_replace(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.+?)(?::[0-9]+)?"))

panels.title: Memory used

panels.description: The version of the cluster's configuration its members should run (desired), and the one each member last took whole. An apply moves them; a member left on another one is in the Configuration tile.

targets.expr: max(janus_cluster_desired_version{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_applied_version{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})

panels.title: Versions

panels.description: Each member as the Controller recorded it: whether its last apply or check failed, each managed domain changed on the node since it was applied (drift), drained.

targets.expr: max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_error{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or on (member) (max by (member) (0 * janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) - 1)
max by (member, domain) (janus_cluster_member_drift{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max by (member) (janus_cluster_member_drained{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or on (member) (max by (member) (0 * janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) - 1)

panels.title: Members' health

panels.description: An operation running on the cluster - an apply, a member added or removed, a scale, a recycle - and whether the last one failed (until the next starts).

targets.expr: max(janus_cluster_operation_running{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or on () (0 * count(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) - 1)
max(janus_cluster_operation_failed{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"}) or on () (0 * count(janus_cluster_info{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster"}) - 1)

panels.title: Operations

panels.description: The cluster's members, those that answered the Controller's last load reading (every 15 s), and the count [auto-scaling](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/clusters.md#scaling) judges - the one it simulates while observing.

targets.expr: max(janus_cluster_members{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max(janus_cluster_load_members{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max(janus_cluster_autoscale_judged_members{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})

panels.title: Member count

panels.description: The members' load as the Controller reads it every 15 s - what horizontal auto-scaling judges: HAProxy's idle time and the CPUs' busy and steal time, the means over the members, and the highest share of maxconn in use. Steal above 10 %: the hosts are saturated.

targets.expr: max(janus_cluster_load_haproxy_idle_ratio{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max(janus_cluster_load_cpu_busy_ratio{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max(janus_cluster_load_cpu_steal_ratio{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})
max(janus_cluster_load_connections_ratio{job="$controller", cluster_name="$cluster"})

panels.title: Load
